WITH s AS (
  SELECT app_id, channel, new_user sn, recharge_amount sr, last_day_retention_num sd1, last7_day_retention_num sd7
  FROM ads.ads_channel_summary_d_paimon_shadow WHERE date_key='2026-11-12'
), f AS (
  SELECT app_id, channel, new_user fn, recharge_amount fr, last_day_retention_num fd1, last7_day_retention_num fd7
  FROM ads.ads_channel_summary_d WHERE date_key='2026-11-12'
)
SELECT s.app_id, s.channel,
  s.sn AS shadow_new, f.fn AS formal_new, (s.sn-f.fn) AS d_new,
  s.sd1 AS shadow_d1r, f.fd1 AS formal_d1r,
  s.sd7 AS shadow_d7r, f.fd7 AS formal_d7r
FROM s INNER JOIN f ON s.app_id=f.app_id AND s.channel=f.channel
WHERE s.sn<>f.fn OR s.sd1<>f.fd1 OR s.sd7<>f.fd7 OR s.sr<>f.fr
ORDER BY ABS(s.sn-f.fn) DESC
LIMIT 12

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `dws`.`dws_app_page_visit_d_d_paimon_shadow` (
  `dt` date NOT NULL COMMENT "业务日",
  `app_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT "产品",
  `page_key` varchar(64) NOT NULL COMMENT "页面",
  `page_name` varchar(512) NULL COMMENT "页面名",

COMMENT "页面访问影子表，Spark 回写；uid_cnt=字典号 bitmap，对齐正式表接口"
